# Fidelity

Two parts: the **parity checklist** (per feature, hand-written; Complete = every row passes) and the
**fidelity ledger** (per exe function, generated by `slr-ledger` from address annotations and local test results;
see ADR 0004, 0008, 0009). Per-function evidence is recorded below; all feature-parity rows remain open.
See `docs/boot-status.md` for the canonical current assessment; `docs/re-progress.md`
contains historical subsystem reports. The playable game in
`slr-core`/`slr-game` is the old approximation; it is deleted at headless boot (plan M1-14).

Generalized VM and engine paths used by the boot driver are validated only to
its compared whole-run prefix unless a ledger row names a per-function oracle.
Successful stock script execution is not an exactness claim; current native-log
and script-node gaps are recorded in `docs/boot-status.md`.

## Whole-game completion contract

Authority: [glossary](../GLOSSARY.md), [plan](plan.md),
[ADR 0004](adr/0004-exact-function-level-port.md), ADRs 0007–0009, and
[specification #1](https://github.com/nicolas-found42/street-legal/issues/1).
Later ADR amendments control acceptance where an earlier tier table differs.
**Complete means all P01–P30 pass their applicable tier tests**, with the
cross-cutting obligations below satisfied. A successful boot, source recovery,
workspace tests, ledger percentage or exact trace prefix cannot substitute for
those feature runs. [VM issue #110](https://github.com/nicolas-found42/street-legal/issues/110)
explicitly retains that distinction between bounded component evidence and
stock boot/whole-game parity.

| Gate | Required evidence before acceptance | Authority |
|---|---|---|
| Stock inputs and runtime | Clean stock media and extracted install remain unchanged; runtime reads original assets and executes unchanged compiled TUFA scripts. Native macOS arm64 game supports windowed/fullscreen operation. No approximate game logic remains in the shipped host; the old slice is removed when headless boot passes. | ADR 0004, 0007; plan M0-02/M0-03, M1-14, M5-10 |
| A: formats | Every stock file parses with corpus counts and no unexplained trailing bytes; exe loader logic has function differential evidence. Writers round-trip formats the exe writes. Standard media uses the declared decoders; decoded output is judged under D. Retain the modded install only as a compatibility corpus. | ADR 0009; plan M2 |
| B: VM and natives | Per-opcode, value-helper and native differential evidence; all 353 registered natives implemented and registered by original address, including those not statically referenced by stock scripts. Complete boot native-call equality against the named original oracle, plus end-to-end scenario logs for each relevant parity row. | ADR 0004, 0008, 0009; plan M1, M4, M7 |
| C: physics, level 1 | Every physics native passes original-function differential tests over random and edge vectors, 0 ulp on trusted operations. Trust and control-word evidence covers the float operations used. No mismatch is hidden by a new tolerance. | ADR 0007–0009; plan M0-07/M0-14, M3-01..M3-09 |
| C: physics, level 2 | Deterministic drag, braking and collision sessions for every stock car match original per-frame vehicle state bit for bit on trusted operations. P25 covers all 24 racer models; P26 covers every stock part and its effects. | ADR 0009; plan M3-10; P25/P26 |
| D: rendering | Per-frame D3D9-equivalent states, stages, transforms and draw streams equal original hooked logs in deterministic replay. Named-scene perceptual screenshot comparisons have human review of failures. The native window and real display path are exercised. | ADR 0009; plan M5 |
| D: audio | DirectSound-equivalent buffer, playback, volume, pan, frequency and 3D call streams equal original logs. Human listening evidence exists per applicable parity item. Sample-exact audio is not required. | ADR 0009; plan M6 |
| D: input | Keyboard, mouse and gamepad/wheel work through original ControlSet scripts with DirectInput semantics; deterministic DirectInput call streams match the original. Force feedback remains out of scope. | ADR 0008/0009; plan M6-04 |
| E: saves/config | The same scripted session yields byte-identical original SDAT save/config files; port saves load in the original and original saves load in the port. Exercise career and options persistence. | ADR 0004 as amended, 0009; plan M7-01/M7-02 |
| Exceptions and evidence hygiene | Each original-bug fix is confirmed in build 606 and ledgered with precise trigger inputs; comparisons exclude only those inputs. CD-check checksum replacement is ledgered. Function annotations and regenerated ledger agree with current local test evidence; original-derived vectors/traces/assets stay ignored and oracle tooling stays outside the shipped workspace. | ADR 0004, 0007–0009; plan ground rules, M7-03/M7-04 |

### Evidence required for a passing parity row

Keep the P01–P30 table above as the single feature-status inventory. Replace
`open` only after its end-to-end deterministic session passes every applicable
tier gate. A passing row names the oracle that actually ran and links its local
ignored evidence bundle (or a durable tool/recipe that regenerates that bundle).
For features spanning tiers, list evidence for each tier; native-only or
per-function evidence does not establish rendering, audio, input, save or
whole-session acceptance.

Each bundle must identify the source revision including uncommitted changes,
stock/exe identities, oracle and declared shim boundaries, replay seed/time/input
schedule, feature coverage, complete compared outputs, first-divergence results,
and any required human visual/listening review. Preserve failed attempts and
report unsupported observations. A declared headless device or shim is an input
to that scenario, not proof of physical device behaviour. Never substitute
captured oracle outputs for executable runtime behaviour or accept a common
prefix as a complete session.

For P01, [boot-status.md](boot-status.md) defines the narrower boot endpoint:
completed MainMenu dialog construction plus at least 300 idle frames, matching
filtered native logs through that endpoint, with unfiltered/node divergences
fixed or explicitly recorded. `re/boot-diagnose.py` is the fail-closed boot
comparison runner; its success alone does not close P01's intro/render tests or
any other parity row. Other feature scenarios still require their own replay
and tier-specific comparisons. Repository formatting, Clippy, workspace tests,
ledger regeneration and a Jev gate validate each implementation checkpoint;
they are additional checks, not whole-game parity evidence.

Current feature status remains the table above: every row is `open`. The canonical
boot frontier and current work-in-progress limits remain in
[boot-status.md](boot-status.md); this contract does not promote any existing
component or historical boot receipt to feature acceptance.

### Final integrated verification

After the implementation meets the gates above, freeze the candidate Git revision,
stock/exe identities, oracle code and shim profile, replay inputs, tool versions,
and comparison policy. Rebuild and rerun the complete acceptance matrix against
those frozen inputs in an independent verification pass. Preserve the complete
outputs and failed attempts. Record the verifier, exact reproduction commands,
all P01–P30 results, cross-cutting gate results, and required human review receipts.
Investigate discrepancies, correct the implementation, then freeze the corrected
revision and repeat affected verification before accepting it. An implementation
checkpoint is not this final whole-game verification.

Do not treat an omitted scenario, missing local vectors, skipped test, untrusted
float operation, unavailable device observation or absent human review as a pass.
Record the missing evidence and keep the affected obligation open. A source hash
identifies bytes but cannot recreate them: retain a committed source revision or
the actual tracked patch and untracked source archive needed to rebuild every
candidate. A frozen binary alone is insufficient for source reproducibility.

### Exception evidence does not relax the contract

The intentional-divergence table below inventories differences; inclusion alone
does not establish that a difference satisfies ADR 0007. Preserve original results
and demonstrate each build-606 bug on its precise trigger, then verify the corrected
port behavior separately. Exclude only the confirmed trigger from equality checks.
Do not normalize an entire result class (for example every NaN sphere radius) to
the port's preferred value to make the comparison pass.

ADR 0007's bit-exact transcendental requirement remains part of the contract.
The `APPROX` classifications in [x87.md](x87.md) and tolerance-based implementations
in `slr-x87` do not establish that requirement. Pinning a documented implementation
under ADR 0008 does not by itself prove parity with the original. Resolve the
evidence gap for affected operations and scenarios; any proposed relaxation is a
material fidelity decision requiring explicit authority, not a test adjustment.

## Intentional divergences

| Exe function | What differs | Why | Trigger inputs |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FUN_005195e0` domain parser (via `FUN_00519110` / `FUN_0051a140`) | an unknown domain keyword or a truncated line makes the exe store a pointer into its own stack frame as the domain (state lines first free the previous domain); the port keeps the previous value (state) or `None` (action) | memory-unsafe original bug, confirmed by reading build 606 disassembly (`0x5195e0` returns its 3rd argument); not run in build 606 | `source_size blob 1 2 3`, `source s0 5 point 0 0 0` (no velocity domain) |
| `FUN_005195e0` sphere | missing radius fields retain argument-slot data in the original; the port defaults only missing fields to 0 and retains a supplied radius | Build-606 execution under the declared Unicorn allocator/stack preserves NaN words for the absent second radius and its square. These are not equivalent to zero. `re/oracle/particle_vectors.py` retains raw words; `particle_oracle` separately asserts the original bug and corrected radius words, excluding only the affected radius fields from equality. Earlier normalized captures are rejected by schema. | Measured inputs only: state witnesses `source_size sphere 1 2 3` and `source_size sphere 1 2 3 2`; active `source s0 20` or `40` followed by `point 0.00 0.00 0.00 sphere 1.00 1.00 1.00` in stock/compatibility asphalt, sand and water cfgs. Other trigger forms remain unaccepted. |
| `FUN_0051a140`, `FUN_00519110`, `FUN_00521e10` | a number that fails to convert leaves uninitialised stack / heap in the exe; the port keeps 0 (or the documented default) | unspecified original behaviour | `+3`, `.5`, `abc`, missing fields; skid scripts without `maxcount` |
| `FUN_005511c0` / `FUN_0051ac20` | lines over 1023 bytes and `%s` labels over 63 bytes overflow fixed stack buffers; a last line without `\n` reads heap garbage past the file; the port truncates labels at 63 bytes and stops at end of data | original buffer overflows | lines > 1023 bytes, labels > 63 bytes |
| `FUN_00531e90` (`.bon`/`.skl`), `FUN_00532e70` (`.matrixdata`) | the port returns an error where the exe reads out of bounds or keeps stale stack values: truncated files, a bone line that fails to scan, a parent index past the bone count, a cyclic parent table, a file whose last name line has no `\n` (exe reads past the buffer), trailing bytes that do not form a whole bone (exe builds a phantom bone) | memory safety; no shipped file triggers any of them | malformed input only (corpus: 0) |
| `FUN_00401480` (CD check), `texture.dat` | not ported; startup verifies the clean `stock/` install by SHA-256 and size of every file against `stock/.slr-manifest` (`slr_io::stock`, called from `slr-game` main) and refuses to start on a missing, truncated or altered file, a manifest that lacks files (entry count pinned to 7,858) or vouches for another exe, or a missing manifest. The manifest is generated locally by `tools/extract-stock.sh` (needs the stock media; git-ignored, never committed); only the two exe SHA-256 values already published in that script are pinned in code. Files not in the manifest are tolerated. Tested: 13 data-free unit tests on a synthetic tree plus a corpus test over the real 7,858 files (agrees with the script's `shasum`) | no disc on macOS | always |
| `FUN_0041ab60` / `FUN_00417da0` (assignment store, `slr-vm`) | CLOSED by ticket #31: storing an `I`/`F` value into an `L`-typed variable now converts through `loader_convert` (the `FUN_00417da0` static port: String load + `%d`/`%.3f` + interning) when the interpreter's loader is present; loader-less `Alu::store` still logs and copies the raw word (unreachable on live scripts). The 14 `known_divergence` rows in `re/out/thread` still pin the loader-less replay gap | class model landed in M1-04 | assignment kinds `0x23 0x26 0x27 0x28 0x2c 0x2d 0x2e` with an `L` destination and an `I`/`F` source |

| `FUN_00486120` / `FUN_0054c650` / `FUN_00558ba0` (File.move) | missing-parent retry: original creates an empty destination then MoveFileA fails because that destination exists (UINT_MAX, source retained); port creates parent directories only, then moves successfully (0, source removed, original bytes at destination) | build-606 native/layer/helper executed under Unicorn with controlled Win32 API boundaries; original and corrected results asserted separately; ADR 0007, #107 | source `data/cars/source.bin` bytes `00534c52ff`, destination `save/missing/new.bin`, initial directories `data` and `data/cars`; source exists and destination parents are absent |


| `LAB_0047df40`, `FUN_00486c80`, `FUN_00486cd0` (GameRef flags) | original reads through native node+0xc when Native.ptr is zero; port getFlags returns 0 and setters do nothing | build-606 native code under Unicorn; confirmed reads at 0xc; ADR 0007, #37 | null native node: recorded resource row1 with node=false,bound=true,id=9,mode=3,flags=0x12345678,mask=0x123,gate=false,precache=1,target/arg/text=true,terminal=false |
| `LAB_0047d4b0`, `LAB_0047d570`, `LAB_0047d630`, `LAB_0047d6f0` (ResourceRef relatives) | original reads node+8 (parent/root) or node+0xc (children) when Native.ptr is zero; port returns no relative (0) | build-606 native code under Unicorn; confirmed reads at 0x8/0xc; ADR 0007, #37 | same null-native-node row1 input state as the flags row above; these four getter cases only |
| `LAB_0047d3e0` (getParentID) | original reads parent+0x50 when the bound resource has no parent; port returns 0 | build-606 native code under Unicorn; confirmed read at 0x50; ADR 0007, #37 | recorded resource row7: same state above except node=true,target=false; native node id9 points to a live mode3 resource whose parent is zero |

Original bugs (Proofix list, build 936) are added here as each one is confirmed in build 606 and fixed (plan M7-03).

Particle evidence is regenerated into a fresh ignored directory, never over the
previous capture. The first command runs the original loaders, the second
independently replays their raw words, and the third checks exact output outside
the measured exception plus original-bug/corrected-output assertions:

```sh
~/slr-oracle-venv/bin/python re/oracle/particle_vectors.py gen --out re/out/particle-new
~/slr-oracle-venv/bin/python re/oracle/particle_vectors.py verify --out re/out/particle-new
SLR_PARTICLE_VECTORS="$PWD/re/out/particle-new" cargo test -p slr-fmt-cfg --test particle_oracle -- --nocapture
```

After validation, preserve the previous `re/out/particle/` directory in a local
archive before promoting the new directory there for workspace/ledger checks.
The current migration retains legacy normalized fixtures under
`re/out/boot/ownership-20261021T021707Z/particle-legacy/`; raw captures, rejected
comparisons and fresh original replay receipts are under its sibling
`particle-audit/`. The raw suite reports intentional divergences separately;
it does not claim equality for those radius words or whole-feature parity.
